products.short_description: Deploy and manage Microsoft Teams Rooms — resource accounts + licensing, device config + room policies, Pro management-portal monitoring/updates, peripheral standards, and health validation — so rooms are reliable and centrally managed. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Deploy and manage Microsoft Teams Rooms that just work

Meeting rooms fail when Teams Rooms devices aren't deployed and managed to a standard. This solution covers Teams Rooms end to end: resource-account and licensing setup, device configuration and meeting-room policies, the Teams Rooms Pro management portal for monitoring/updates, peripheral and front-of-room standards, and health/validation — so rooms are reliable, consistent, and centrally managed.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Teams Rooms model: resource accounts + licensing (Pro/Basic), device config, room policies, the Pro management portal, and peripherals.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (Teams Rooms licensing, certified hardware, resource mailboxes, network, admin roles).
  • Implementation Guide — create + configure resource accounts, license and enroll devices, apply room/meeting policies, onboard to the Pro management portal (monitoring/updates), set peripheral standards, and validate a pilot room — pilot-first, each account/room named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic MicrosoftTeams PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (rooms join reliably, managed centrally, health green) plus Best Practices for a fleet of consistent rooms.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Meeting rooms that just work — resource accounts and devices configured to a standard, managed from the Pro portal, health monitored — consistent, reliable, centrally run.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • TEAMSROOMS-Discovery.ps1 — TEAMSROOMS-Discovery — Read-only assessment of Microsoft Teams Rooms readiness:
    • TEAMSROOMS-HealthReport.ps1 — TEAMSROOMS-HealthReport — Produce a fleet health/inventory report for Microsoft
    • TEAMSROOMS-Set-ResourceAccount.ps1 — TEAMSROOMS-Set-ResourceAccount — Create and configure a Microsoft Teams Rooms
    • TEAMSROOMS-Set-RoomPolicy.ps1 — TEAMSROOMS-Set-RoomPolicy — Apply the Teams Rooms calendar-processing standard
    • TEAMSROOMS-Validation.ps1 — TEAMSROOMS-Validation — Validate one or more Teams Rooms resource accounts against

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
